sourceReference.relationshipToSdk: Static source reference only; sdk.json pins a distribution binary whose exact source commit/VCL build is not assumed.

scope: Bounded original SDK values/errors and 2x2 Layer pixels; no Web runtime pass and no predeclared VCL output oracle.
recordProtocolNotes: Error messages use native TJS String.escape() and are retained as escaped text, not guessed JSON or decoded text.
Integer inputs/results are decimal strings, so JSON number precision never alters native int64 observations.
effectCount records nativeBadColor getter evaluations within an entry case.
sourceExpectation values are static expectations only; the converter must not copy or assert them as actual outputs.
